newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded a Saudi man for murder, bringing to 36 the number of people executed in the conservative kingdom this year.
An interior ministry statement read on Saudi television said the man, Mohammad bin Suleiman bin Mohammad Darbayan al-Shami, was beheaded by sword for shooting and killing another man.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic law by beheading convicted murders, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
